senses.definition: More than one (of an indeterminate set of things).
examples: There are various ways to fix the problem.
You have broken various of the rules.

senses.definition: Having a broad range (of different elements).

quotes.text: For this scene, a large number of supers are engaged, and in order to further swell the crowd, practically all the available stage hands have to ‘walk on’ dressed in various coloured dominoes, and all wearing masks.
